goal: Integrate unified damage flow from toolkit refactor - use CombatantRegistry and ApplyDamage instead of manual HP calculation
design_decisions: CombatantRegistry holds all combat participants for proper context
ApplyDamage handles traits (vulnerability, resistance, immunity) properly
Character state must be saved after attacks (like ActivateFeature does)
Vulnerability multipliers must appear in AttackResolvedEvent breakdown
next_steps: Bump toolkit dependency to get unified damage flow
Replace manual HP calculation with ApplyDamage
Save character and monster state after attack
Add test scenarios for different class/weapon combos
